setup:
B=$(git branch --show-current)
git checkout -qb incoming
sed -i '' 's/"internal error"/"lookup failed"/' internal/account/handler.go
git -c user.email=eval@neo -c user.name=eval commit -aqm 'incoming: clearer error text'
git checkout -q "$B"
sed -i '' 's/"internal error"/"unexpected error"/' internal/account/handler.go
git -c user.email=eval@neo -c user.name=eval commit -aqm 'mainline: reword error text'
git merge incoming >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
